article.en: I want to tell you a true story.
article.zh: 我要告诉你一个真实的故事。

article.en: It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
article.zh: 这是一年前发生在我的一位朋友身上的事。

article.en: While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
article.zh: 当我的朋友乔治在床上看书时，两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。

article.en: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room.
article.zh: 他们进入房子后，走进了饭厅。

article.en: It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.
article.zh: 屋里很黑，于是他们打开了手电筒。

article.en: Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them.
article.zh: 突然，他们听到身后有声音。
'出什么事了？出什么事了？'有人喊道。

article.en: The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
article.zh: 小偷们扔下手电筒，飞快地逃走了。

article.en: George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
article.zh: 乔治听到响声，赶紧下了楼。

article.en: He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone.
article.zh: 他打开了灯，但一个人也看不见。

article.en: But George's parrot, Henry, was still there.
article.zh: 但乔治的鹦鹉亨利还在那里。
